tasks.title: Add SnapshotsByVehicleBetween to telemetry.Reader interface + AGENTS.md port section

tasks.title: Add SnapshotsByVehicleBetween :many query to query.sql (filter on captured_at, half-open bounds, LIMIT 400, index-reuse comment)
tasks.notes: Added SnapshotsByVehicleBetween :many query to query.sql mirroring Since column list, index-reuse comment, and LIMIT 400. Filters on captured_at TIMESTAMPTZ (NOT captured_date) with half-open bounds >= @start_bound AND < @end_bound. Header comment documents +1day/+2day derivation, EffectiveDate ∈ [start,end] semantics, and why captured_date is forbidden (POLLER_TIMEZONE coupling). Params: account_id, tesla_id, start_bound pgtype.Timestamptz, end_bound pgtype.Timestamptz. GENA codegen pending (task 2.1).

tasks.title: Implement dbStore.snapshotsByVehicleBetween (translate +1day/+2day, call sqlc, map via rowToSnapshot)
